steps.content: Echo, in a tucked-away corner, wraps up her song with a stylish bow and walks away, her hum of a tuneless ditty trailing behind her.
As you ponder over the lyrics, it dawns on you that the Fortuna in them is truly a theater, and intriguingly, it isn't owned by Lady Pearl.
Plunged back into poverty, the theater's former owner reluctantly agreed to a change in ownership, handing over Fortuna to a "savior" lady.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: "Savior" lady... It really is her...!
It becomes clear, the lyrics hint at none other than the current owner of Fortuna, Lady Pearl.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In light of this, it seems I must engage in a "discussion" with you.
A slender piece of paper, drifting in on an unseen wind, lands at your feet. It's the type of manuscript paper Echo uses.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Bend down to retrieve the paper.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hmm? There's more writing on the back?
The paper is inscribed with the ballad the bard just performed. But it appears the careless bard overlooked something—a hidden verse on the back detailing the finale.

"Tents fallen, homes forgotten, we've all lost our way back."
"Our quest leads to a far-off castle, just down that slender path."
"In that haven, struggles vanish, swept up in the communal dance."
"A magnificent dance, erasing every hardship!"
"Join the dance, let joy mend every wound."
"Time marches on, but the dance goes ever on, grand and timeless."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, this is the next part of our script?
A sudden creak echoes. To the right, on the bard's escape route, a door now stands mysteriously at the path's end, with a sliver of an opening.
A frown creases your brow. Now the "slender path" has appeared, your "quest leads to a far-off castle" should also begin. This signifies the script is in play, everything coming to fruition.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry... but I must shatter this unnatural theater to save my friends.
In this expansive space, the music is the only sound, aside from your own breath.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can still feel them around, for now. But harm them, I won't spare you.
Folding the paper away into your pocket, you begin your journey down the path to the castle.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Reach the end and push open the door.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Time to find out what sort of drama awaits.
The glaring lights continue to spin around you, casting a sea of twirling performers.
Lost in a whirlwind of Mania, they laugh and shout, playfully yet sinisterly taunting you.
In the distance, familiar shadows are etched against the backdrop; you stretch out your hand, desperate to hold onto them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ignis... Luvia...!
Yet, as they twirl and dance, they slip away, growing ever more distant from your reach.
You're nudged and shoved by other performers, who use their choreography or props to hinder your advance.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop... don't block me...
You feel the Mania around you intensifying, as you fight to release your hands that are being grasped, eager to press on.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Luvia... Ignis! Wake up, snap out of it!
The harder you fight, the more your vision clouds. The music has lost its tune, with only a ringing in your ears. Still, you're reluctant to join the stage... unable to identify your part.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't... stand in my way!!
You try to release the shackles, but a wave of vertigo sweeps over you, knocking you out cold.
By the time you come to, you've been pushed off the stage by the ensemble of performers.
Behind you, the audience is shrouded in darkness, while before you, there's a frenzied stage you can't seem to join.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Darn it!!
You're still battling a wave of nausea and vertigo when, unexpectedly, someone's hands reach down to help you up.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Oh, you poor thing, the stage has turned its back on you...
In the sparse light, a noble lady emerges in front of you.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Are you longing to be part of that stage?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If you're up for it... I could show you the way in?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You... you're the one behind all this.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've been pulling the strings.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: ...Huh, is that what you really think?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even if it's not true, you're still a part of this... inextricably.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I won't... let you get away.
Struggling to your feet, you turn the situation on its head, grabbing her wrist.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Enough with the charade... Spit out the truth!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Easy there, darling, I understand... you need to do this to unleash your power, don't you?
She guides your left hand to rest on her lower back.
The black satin dress clings enticingly, its bold back cut extending to just above her lower spine.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Come on, you can do... whatever you want.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I won't go easy on you.
Thorny shackles rapidly wrap around your and Lady Pearl's minds. After a wave of familiar dizziness, you're both transported to an isolated, pristine white space, away from the outside world.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What have you done!?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I haven't really done anything; it's just my power at work.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If it's your power, I'd be on the stage at this very moment!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Sorry things didn't work out the way you expected, but capturing me won't halt the play.
With a gesture from Lady Pearl, a window materializes in the stark white void, much like those in private viewing boxes.
The show on stage continues, with not a soul breaking free from its enthrallment.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You're so smart... you ought to have put it together by now.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Yes, I am indeed the owner of Fortuna... but you should know better than anyone what truly nurtures Mania.
You get what she's implying: those desires unmet by reality, the regrets that can't be fixed in real world, all fueling a wish for an alternate life, to transform into another self...
Such potent feelings and thoughts have built an ideal hotbed for Mania.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I just gave them a choice.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This whole play is a creation of their own making, a result of the roles they chose for themselves.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: They desire it, they long for it, for roles, for lives like these.
Lady Pearl moves to stand by your side, observing the performers with you.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Just capturing me won't change anything.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If you want to halt this performance, you'll have to rewrite the script.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But, to rewrite it... you'll have to take on a role within the play.
Lady Pearl tugs at her hat, a playful glint in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I understand you're reluctant to get into character, to act out a part in the script.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But it's exactly for this reason that there's a role that's perfect for you.
The white void fades away like fog, bringing you back to the forefront of the stage.
Lady Pearl reaches out, presenting a gleaming silver-white sword.
It's a longsword fit for the brave, for the hero.
You accept the sword, meeting Lady Pearl's increasingly fervent look.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm just here to save my friends; I won't... be drawn into your storyline.
